title: Experiment! How Does An Owl Fly So Silently? | Super Powered Owls | BBC

segments.description: Medium shot of a trainer holding a pigeon on a stool in a dark studio setting, establishing the flight sound experiment.
Medium tracking shot of the pigeon flying across an array of sensitive studio microphones, capturing the sound of its wingbeats.
Medium shot of a barn owl standing on a covered pedestal in the dark studio, preparing for its silent flight test.
Medium tracking shot of the barn owl taking flight silently past the microphone array, contrasting with the pigeon.
Close-up shot of audio editing software showing visual decibel waveforms of the bird's flight sound data.
Medium shot of a peregrine falcon launching from its perch toward the microphone array during the comparative experiment.
Medium close-up of the barn owl launching into flight with soft, broad wing movements in the studio.
Medium shot of researchers reviewing the silent audio waveforms on a laptop and expressing amazement.
Macro close-up shot of the barn owl's face and specialized soft feathers, highlighting its unique physical adaptations.
High-speed slow-motion shot of a pigeon flying over a bed of white feathers, scattering them with turbulent airflow.
High-speed slow-motion shot of a falcon flying over feathers, demonstrating heavier wing turbulence and speed.
High-speed slow-motion shot of the barn owl gliding effortlessly over feathers with virtually no disturbance, revealing the secret of silent flight.
